lessons.title: L'hiver arrive!
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand that 'hiver' means winter and can identify winter weather signs

main.activity: Winter weather exploration with sensory experiences
visualSupports: Large winter weather photo collection showing snow, ice, frost
Temperature gestures (shivering for froid, warm for chaud)
Real winter items to touch: ice cubes, fake snow, winter gloves
Weather sorting cards for hands-on categorization

closing.activity: Students point outside and say 'C'est l'hiver!' while doing shivering gesture

lessons.realWorldConnection: Winter brings changes in weather, clothing, and activities that affect daily life

lessons.title: Que porte-t-on en hiver?
lessons.oneGoal: Students can name 3 winter clothing items in French

main.activity: Winter clothing exploration with dress-up and movement
visualSupports: Real winter clothing collection for trying on
Clothing gesture cards showing how to wear each item
Before/after pictures: same person in summer vs winter clothes
Cultural winter clothing from different countries

closing.activity: Students model their winter clothing and name one item: 'Je porte mon manteau'

lessons.realWorldConnection: People wear special clothes to stay warm during winter

lessons.title: Activités d'hiver amusantes
lessons.oneGoal: Students can identify winter activities they can do outside

main.activity: Winter activities exploration with movement and imaginative play
visualSupports: Winter activity photos: sledding, skating, building snowmen, skiing
Movement cards showing how to mime each activity
Video clips of children doing winter activities safely
Activity station signs with pictures and French words

closing.activity: Students choose favorite winter activity and demonstrate: 'J'aime glisser!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Winter offers unique outdoor activities and fun experiences

lessons.title: Animaux en hiver
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand how animals prepare for and survive winter

main.activity: Animal winter survival exploration with movement and discovery
visualSupports: Animal winter survival photos: bears sleeping, birds flying south, deer in snow
Animal movement cards for acting out behaviors
Hibernation den photos and migration maps
Before/after photos: animals in summer vs winter

closing.activity: Students choose animal and show winter behavior: 'L'ours dormir en hiver'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Animals have special ways to survive cold winter weather

lessons.title: Célébrations autour du monde
lessons.oneGoal: Students discover that many cultures celebrate during winter season

main.activity: Global winter celebration exploration with cultural appreciation
visualSupports: Photos of diverse winter celebrations from around the world
World map showing where different celebrations happen
Real candles, string lights, lanterns (safely demonstrated)
Cultural celebration music and sounds
Family celebration photos representing different traditions

closing.activity: Students point to celebration photo and say: 'C'est une belle célébration!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Many cultures have special celebrations during winter months

lessons.title: Noël autour du monde
lessons.oneGoal: Students explore how Christmas is celebrated in different French-speaking countries

main.activity: Christmas traditions exploration with French cultural focus
visualSupports: Christmas photos from French-speaking countries
Different types of Christmas trees and decorations
Cultural Christmas foods and traditions photos
Simple French Christmas song with picture supports
Craft materials for cultural Christmas decoration

closing.activity: Students show their Christmas craft and say: 'Joyeux Noël!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Christmas is celebrated differently around the world, including in French-speaking countries

lessons.title: Hanoukka - Festival des lumières
lessons.oneGoal: Students learn about Hanukkah as a winter celebration of lights

main.activity: Hanukkah exploration with respectful cultural learning
visualSupports: Beautiful Hanukkah celebration photos showing families
Menorah photos and safe demonstration model
Number cards 1-8 for counting practice
Simple Hanukkah story picture book
Craft template for paper menorah

closing.activity: Students count to huit and point to their menorah craft

lessons.realWorldConnection: Hanukkah is an important winter festival celebrating religious freedom and miracles

lessons.title: Kwanzaa - Célébration africaine-américaine
lessons.oneGoal: Students discover Kwanzaa as a cultural winter celebration

main.activity: Kwanzaa exploration with cultural appreciation and respect
visualSupports: Respectful Kwanzaa celebration photos
Kinara (candleholder) photos and demonstration model
Red, black, and green color displays
Community helper photos showing unity and cooperation
Number cards for counting to seven

closing.activity: Students count sept candles and say one community value

lessons.realWorldConnection: Kwanzaa celebrates African-American culture and community values

lessons.title: Diwali d'hiver et autres fêtes
lessons.oneGoal: Students explore other cultural celebrations that can happen in winter

main.activity: Diverse winter celebration exploration with inclusive cultural appreciation
visualSupports: Beautiful photos of lanterns from different cultures
Diwali celebration photos (if occurring in winter)
Winter solstice explanation with simple day/night visuals
Various cultural light celebration photos
Craft materials for simple lantern making

closing.activity: Students hold their lantern craft and name one winter tradition

lessons.realWorldConnection: Many cultures have light-based celebrations during dark winter months

lessons.title: Nouvel An autour du monde
lessons.oneGoal: Students discover different New Year celebrations and traditions

main.activity: New Year celebration exploration with hope and renewal themes
visualSupports: New Year celebration photos from different cultures
Calendar showing different new year dates
Fireworks photos and dragon dance videos
Wish and hope gesture demonstrations
Noise maker craft materials

closing.activity: Students shake their noise makers and shout: 'Bonne année!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Different cultures celebrate new year at different times with unique traditions

lessons.title: Cuisine d'hiver réconfortante
lessons.oneGoal: Students explore comfort foods and special dishes from winter celebrations

main.activity: Winter comfort food exploration with cultural food appreciation
visualSupports: Diverse cultural winter food photos
Real food samples for safe smelling and observing
Cooking demonstration props (safe utensils, empty containers)
Cultural food-celebration matching cards
Seasonal spice bottles for safe sensory exploration

closing.activity: Students show their winter menu and name one comfort food

lessons.realWorldConnection: Special foods and warm drinks are important parts of winter celebrations

lessons.title: Musique et chansons d'hiver
lessons.oneGoal: Students learn songs and music from different winter celebrations

main.activity: Winter celebration music exploration with movement and cultural appreciation
visualSupports: Musical instruments from different cultures
Song lyric cards with picture supports
Cultural dance photos and videos
Music recording equipment for class song creation
Movement scarves and props for dancing

closing.activity: Students choose their favorite winter song and hum together

lessons.realWorldConnection: Music and songs are essential parts of cultural celebrations

lessons.title: Créons nos décorations
lessons.oneGoal: Students create winter celebration decorations from different cultures

main.activity: Multicultural decoration creation with artistic expression and cultural appreciation
visualSupports: Photos of decorations from different cultural celebrations
Cultural color meaning charts
Step-by-step craft instruction cards
Examples of finished decorations from each culture
Decoration station signs with pictures and instructions

closing.activity: Students display their decorations and share cultural inspiration

lessons.realWorldConnection: People decorate their homes and communities for winter celebrations

lessons.title: Notre festival d'hiver multiculturel
lessons.oneGoal: Students participate in a classroom winter celebration festival

main.activity: Culminating multicultural winter festival celebration
visualSupports: Festival setup with multicultural decoration displays
Station signs representing different cultural celebrations
Photo documentation of student learning journey
Community gathering photos showing people celebrating together
Celebration music playlist representing all cultures studied

closing.activity: Group circle celebrating diversity: 'Toutes les célébrations sont belles!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Communities often hold winter festivals celebrating cultural diversity

lessons.title: Histoires d'hiver magiques
lessons.oneGoal: Students explore winter stories and legends from different cultures

main.activity: Multicultural winter storytelling with imagination and cultural appreciation
visualSupports: Cultural winter storybooks with beautiful illustrations
Story prop basket with winter items: snowflakes, stars, lights
Story illustration examples from different cultures
Visual story sequence cards
Cultural storytelling tradition photos

closing.activity: Students share one word from their favorite winter story

lessons.realWorldConnection: Cultures share winter stories that teach values and traditions

familyConnections.unitLetter:
Chers parents et familles,

Nous sommes ravis de commencer notre nouvelle unité: "Célébrations d'hiver"

Cette unité permettra à votre enfant de:
• Explorer des concepts importants en français
• Développer du vocabulaire en français
• Pratiquer de nouvelles compétences
• Faire des connexions avec la vie quotidienne

Quelques thèmes que nous explorerons:
L'hiver arrive!, Que porte-t-on en hiver?, Activités d'hiver amusantes, Animaux en hiver, Célébrations autour du monde

Comment vous pouvez aider à la maison:
• Demandez à votre enfant de partager ce qu'il/elle a appris
• Pratiquez le nouveau vocabulaire ensemble (voir la liste ci-jointe)
• Essayez les activités suggérées quand vous avez du temps
• Célébrez les efforts et les progrès, pas seulement les résultats

Il est normal et bénéfique que votre enfant mélange les langues à la maison.

N'hésitez pas à me contacter si vous avez des questions ou si vous souhaitez partager des ressources culturelles liées à cette unité.

Merci pour votre soutien continu dans l'apprentissage du français!

Cordialement,
[Nom de l'enseignant(e)]
